import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
k = rng.integers(0, 5, 10000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (5, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (10000, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['group'] = pd.Categorical(['Alpha', 'Beta', 'Gamma', 'Delta', 'Epsilon'][v] for v in k)
df.shape

steps.name: open annotate tab and label by group
steps.eval: document.querySelector('#tab-annotate').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const col = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'group').index; const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Label by"]'); sel.value = String(col); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: FontPicker combobox is rendered (input element present)
apply Cinzel font via Atlas API
font is loaded (document.fonts.check)
steps.eval: await document.fonts.ready; window.__fontLoaded = document.fonts.check('16px Cinzel') || document.fonts.check('600 16px Cinzel') || [...document.fonts.values()].some(f => f.family === 'Cinzel')
steps.report: { fontLoaded: window.__fontLoaded, families: [...document.fonts.values()].map(f => f.family).filter((f,i,a) => a.indexOf(f) === i).slice(0,10) }

steps.name: labels render with Cinzel (pixels present)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__cinzelPixels = n

steps.name: apply UPPERCASE case
steps.eval: const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Letter case"]'); sel.value = 'upper'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))
